newsitem.title: UK: BOXING-JANUARY DATE LIKELY FOR LEWIS-MCCALL BOUT.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-JANUARY DATE LIKELY FOR LEWIS-MCCALL BOUT.

text.p: Britain's Lennox Lewis is likely to fight American Oliver McCall for the vacant WBC heavyweight title in Nashville, Tennessee, in January, Lewis's manager Frank Maloney said on Friday.
But confusion still surrounds the timing and location of the bout to fill the title vacated by Mike Tyson, with promoter Don King saying the date could be shifted to February 8 in Britain.
"I've two contracts for the fight and King is indicating it will be January 11," said Frank Maloney.
King and WBC president Jose Sulaiman have been ordered to appear in a New Jersey court on November 14 to "show cause" why the WBC extended the fight deadline by a month from December 26.

The highest purse bid came from King -- $9.15 million submitted on September 26 -- and a bout should have gone ahead within 90 days of the winning offer being opened at the WBC's Mexico City headquarters.
